document_name: High Court of Kerala, WP(C) No. 1234/2023

sections.heading: Background & Facts
sections.content: Case: Permit quashed for lack of environmental clearance in 4,500 sq.m. commercial project near Vembanad Lake.

sections.heading: Judicial Precedent & Void Ab Initio Principle
sections.content: Key Holding: Building permits issued without mandatory environmental clearance under Building Rules Section 12(3) are void ab initio and liable to be quashed.

sections.heading: Demolition Order & Departmental Inquiry
sections.content: Relief: Demolition ordered + departmental inquiry ordered against issuing officer for granting building permit in violation of Section 12(3).
